title: crate-jmap (rev 573c573): MemoryBackend grows without bound outside tests; no chosen-id insert; ChatBackend can't pass calls through
description: Found by A2 (mimid-agent-jmap, 2026-11-16). (1) MemoryBackend event lists are drained only by test-only methods, so a real embedder leaks: create_message pushes an entry per Message (crate-jmap-chat-server/src/memory.rs:1310), outbound events (memory.rs:1623), lifecycle events (memory.rs:594). A2 avoids all three (create_object for Messages, ignores outbound events, no lifecycle hooks). (2) create_object calls the build closure once with the minted id (backend.rs:559, :680): a wrapper that must act before storing builds with a placeholder id and rebuilds via serde. (3) seed_object (memory.rs:482) bypasses the change log; the only alternative is test-only, so a backend cannot store an object under an id it chose (blocks hash-derived ChatContact ids in the agent, as mimid-server uses). (4) ChatBackend (backend.rs:535) has no passthrough/default delegation, so wrapping MemoryBackend hand-forwards ~30 methods. Raise with the crate-jmap session/owner; A5 (persistence) will want (1) and (3) fixed.
notes:
crate-jmap session accepted 2026-11-19: JMAP-it7g.3-.6 (bounded event lists, id-first create, chosen-id store with change log, delegating ChatBackend).
